Name: Luau Soup
Author: ArsonistPH
Description:
- Adds the Luau Soup which can be crafted with Tomato, Tuna, Hot Pepper, Corn, and any Milk. Gives 2 Farming, 1 Luck, and 1 Speed. Gives 250 Energy. Gives 112 Health.

- Pay a visit to Marnie to buy a certain recipe ?

Downloads.Description:
Ever wanted to taste the Luau's Soup? Well now you can! Gus has made a recreation of the soup from the Luau.

You don't know how many time I've typed Luau. It doesn't even sound like a real word anymore.

Manifest.Description: Make and eat the soup from the Luau!
